primary_test_configuration.outfit: Soft ivory blouse with restrained blue-gray detailing and a modest dark skirt
primary_test_configuration.fit: Natural adult fit with comfortable ease, clean seams, plausible garment structure, and no anatomy-obscuring excess fabric
primary_test_configuration.fabric: Lightweight realistic woven fabric with controlled folds and matte-to-soft natural response
primary_test_configuration.footwear: Simple low-profile dark flats or understated low heels appropriate to the interior setting
primary_test_configuration.accessories: Minimal accessories only; small unobtrusive earrings or a simple hair tie may be used, but no recurring signature item
primary_test_configuration.season: Mild spring or early autumn indoor styling
primary_test_configuration.styling: Refined Japanese-inspired, romantic, dreamy, practical, modest, and subordinate to Inaria's identity

identity_coordination.character: Keep the recognizable age-20 face, core facial proportions, dark blue-black hair, blue eyes, intended adult body proportions, and natural skin visible and unobstructed. Clothing must not become an identity signal.
identity_coordination.scene: The ivory and blue-gray palette supports the pale wood, translucent curtains, and soft window light without blending the figure into the background.
identity_coordination.pose_camera: Use garments that remain stable in front, three-quarter, seated, and moderate environmental framing. Avoid collars, sleeves, hair ties, or accessories that obscure the jaw, neck, eyes, hands, or major body landmarks.
identity_coordination.prompt: Include the approved clothing configuration as descriptive support after identity, anatomy, pose, and camera requirements. Negative prompt must reject distracting, overly revealing, malformed, fused, floating, or physically impossible garments.
identity_coordination.director: Apply priority order: identity, age, body proportions, anatomy, pose and camera, clothing construction and fit, scene and lighting, then decorative detail.

locked_requirements: Clothing must support Inaria age-20 identity rather than define it
Adult age presentation and intended body proportions must remain stable
Garments must be modest, non-distracting, and anatomically plausible
No clothing may obscure or alter the recognizable face, dark blue-black hair, or blue eyes
Hands, feet, joints, and body landmarks must remain inspectable where visible
Five-finger hands and five-toe bare feet are required when exposed
No extra, missing, fused, or duplicated digits, limbs, closures, straps, or garment components
Fabric, seams, hems, collars, sleeves, waistlines, and footwear must intersect the body cleanly
No transparent exposure, accidental nudity, extreme cleavage, implausible compression, or distracting logos
Accessories must remain minimal and must not become recurring identity cues
Any repaired clothing asset requires a complete identity, anatomy, pose, scene, and prompt recheck
adjustable_choices: Blouse collar and restrained blue-gray detailing
Cardigan layering when compatible with the pose
Low flats versus understated low heels
Small neutral earrings, simple hair tie, or no accessory
Warm ivory, muted blue-gray, charcoal, navy, and soft taupe color relationships
Sleeve length and light seasonal layering
Tucked, untucked, or partially layered blouse treatment

acceptance_checks: Outfit does not cause apparent age drift or alter perceived body proportions

Face and neck remain readable in all approved clothing variants

Pose and camera changes do not create clothing-body intersections
Clothing variation is distributed across samples rather than permanently locking one outfit, color, shoe, or accessory
No accidental recurring clothing or background cue competes with identity

locked_constraints: Recognizable face, face structure, major facial features, and core facial proportions must remain stable

Intended adult body proportions must remain stable
